title: Clean fit whose FDA warning letter was formally closed three months ago

input.facts: Molecular assay kits run on its own installed instruments: consumables and service are 72% of sales. In 2025 the FDA issued a warning letter on its main assay plant and shipments to the US were held; remediation was completed and the FDA issued a close-out letter in July 2026. US shipments have fully resumed. The share price fell 33% during the shipment hold. Leverage 2.3x. No holder above 25%. No open regulatory issue.

why: The regulatory issue is resolved (FDA close-out letter), so the kill criterion 'major unresolved regulatory issue' is not met, and the drop came from a temporary shipment hold. A past issue that is formally closed is not a kill criterion.
